        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==3]
    for (r,c) in seeds:
        block=[[5,5,5,5,5],[2,0,5,0,2],[2,0,3,0,2],[2,0,0,0,2]]
        for k,v in enumerate(block):
            for j,x in enumerate(v):
                ii, jj = r-2+k, c-2+j
                if 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W: out[ii][jj]=x
        for j in range(W): out[r+2][j]=2
        for j in range(c-2,c+3): out[r+2][j]=8
    return out
